findings.title: Boolean-gated CMS disclosure
findings.finding: The public content projection passes announcement and donation objects through unchanged. When donations are paused, the UI hides QR, UPI, and bank destinations but unauthenticated GET /api/content still returns those stale or unverified values; disabled announcement fields are similarly exposed.
findings.action: Create a public DTO that redacts values hidden by parent publication switches while retaining the complete document behind /api/admin/content, and add raw-response tests for paused donation details and disabled announcement URLs.

findings.title: Production API-origin override
findings.finding: VITE_API_URL is honored before the relative production endpoint even though it is documented as local-development-only. A stale or compromised production build variable can route hidden-login credentials, bearer tokens, uploads, protected CMS data, and donor PII to another origin.
findings.action: Ignore VITE_API_URL outside import.meta.env.DEV, or reject any production API origin different from window.location.origin, and add a production-mode assertion.

findings.title: Certificate modal focus escape
findings.finding: The certificate overlay declares aria-modal and handles initial focus, Escape, and focus restoration, but it neither traps Tab nor makes background controls inert. Keyboard users can move into operable navigation and donation controls hidden behind the overlay.
findings.action: Use a native dialog opened with showModal() or implement focus containment plus an inert background, then browser-check forward and reverse Tab, Escape, backdrop closure, and return focus.
